name: extc-lsp
description: Language support for extC: diagnostics, outline, hover, go-to-definition, completion and syntax highlighting.

extc.mode.description: How to reach the server. `wsl` starts it through wsl.exe from a Windows VS Code; `native` starts it directly (Remote-WSL or Linux). `auto` picks based on whether VS Code runs a remote extension host.

extc.repoPath.description: Path of the extC checkout **as the server sees it** (inside WSL).

extc.wslDistro.description: WSL distribution name; empty means the default one.

extc.python.description: Python interpreter that runs tools/extc-lsp.py (inside the environment that has the checkout).
